listing.name: Punk Junker Hulls
listing.summary: Adds a set of five custom hulls—1 fighter, 1 frigate, 2 destroyers, and 1 carrier—along with a shared hullmod, all inspired by 2013 sprites by Thule.

description:
Scrolling the modding resources I came across the excellent set of sprites by

Thule

from 2013, which never seems to have received a proper implementation. As such I took it upon myself to properly add some of the more interesting ships into the game.

Download Here

This mod adds:

1 Fighter (1 wing)

1 Frigate

2 Destroyers

1 Carrier

It also adds 1 built-in hullmod shared by the ships.

Upon adding this you will find the hulls as one of the rarer choices in pirate fleets.

Should be safe to add to an active game, (But not removing).

The ships in question (bar 1):

Spoiler[close]

Some quick QnA:

SpoilerQuote

How balanced is this?

The ships should be roughly in par with vanilla ships, with their own quirks. That being said, it is being balanced against a somewhat modded setup, so feel free to give feedback if any aspect feels either too strong or like I've pre-nerfed some aspect too hard.

Quote

Hey, I'm from the future and you haven't updated this mod in a while, is it safe to install

Most likely, barring some major rework of how ships are set up, it should not break. The one script added, the hullmod, is pretty basic, and is compiled dynamically, meaning it is also pretty unlikely to break, but if something is to break, that is likely the cause. If so what you can do is to delete the entire hullmod folder, and then remove the reference to the hullmod in each .ship file.

Quote

Hey, future dude again, you still haven't updated the mod, and I would like to fork it / patch it myself, is that ok?

Yeah man, go nuts, eat nuts, no need for permission, such is the spirit of modding. Just like Thule shared his sprites for people to work on, I'm sharing my scripts to use however you'd like.

[close]
